node.statement: Choose e additionally so C_m*e<1. Apply the close-idempotent rank lemma to E=T_ab and F=Co_{R_a,R_b}; node 1.2.1 gives rank(T_ab)=1 and def-compressed-corner gives range(Co_{R_a,R_b})=S_{R_a,R_b}, so dim S_{R_a,R_b}=1 for every a,b. The case a=b says dim S_{R_a}=1, so each R_a is one-dimensional; the cases a,b arbitrary say the R_a are pairwise equivalent by def-one-dimensional-delta-projection. Together with their C_m*e projection defects, this proves node 1.2 with a universal threshold independent of r.
